decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (03 A and Location Plan. Received 01/12/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the details on the approved plans, before the new entrance door is installed a permanent ramp shall be installed to serve the existing rear entrance, with associated handrails. This must comply with the requirements of Part M Volume 2 of the Building Regulations (published March 2015) and is to be retained indefinitely.  Before the new entrance is brought into use, the 'Access at rear' sign shown on drawing 623 03 B shall be installed as shown and shall be permanently retained thereafter
description: Alterations to form new frontage by replacing windows with an entrance door.
